title: Bitrix24 CLI connection configuration, version 1
description: Non-secret user configuration. Credentials remain in managed dotenv files. See configuration.md for selection and additional runtime checks.
$comment: CLI additionally verifies defaultProfile exists, credential references are unique, exact JSON integer literals, permissions/ownership/symlinks, credential file existence and matching HTTPS hostname. The default keyword is an annotation and does not write values.

version.description: Only schema version 1 is supported. CLI requires the literal integer 1.

defaultProfile.description: Saved profile alias or null. Runtime verifies that a non-null alias exists in profiles.

profiles.description: Independent portal profiles. An empty object is valid; an array is not.

telemetry.description: Local problem cards and analysis dates, independent of portal profiles. Collection never enables automatic transmission.

profileAlias.description: Case-sensitive alias used by --profile and connection:use.

hostname.description: Bare ASCII hostname with labels of 1..63 characters, without scheme, port, slash, userinfo, query, whitespace or a trailing dot.

credentialFile.description: Managed relative reference beneath the configuration directory, with forward slashes. CLI currently generates a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal ID.

positiveId.description: Positive ID within signed 64-bit PHP_INT_MAX. CLI additionally requires JSON integer literal syntax (not 1.0 or 1e0).

name.description: Descriptive portal domain; never used for DNS/HTTP. May differ from connection.hostname.

hostname.description: HTTPS transport hostname; must match the hostname of the secret webhook at runtime.

default.description: Optional task creation defaults and local user working-role selectors for this profile.

groupId.description: Default group/project ID, used only when task:add has no explicit groupId.

creatorId.description: Default task creator (author). Uses the REST 3.0 field name.

allowsTimeTracking.description: Whether task time tracking is enabled. Explicit task input wins, then profile value, then built-in false.

taskDefaults.description: Optional defaults. Missing participant IDs still require explicit creatorId/responsibleId at task creation; the webhook user is not inferred.

observerId.description: Local CLI role selector for the default observer, never sent as an API field.

managerId.description: Local working manager, selected explicitly by users:manager --source config.

autoAddObserver.description: Opt in to assigning observerId after task creation; requires observerId when true.
